title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I want to know the details of two names; boy name Zain and girl name Reyanna. Are these good names from Islamic perspective. Should we keep these names of our children or change them? 5241 views Q. Are both these names right Zaakirah and Zakeerah? The former means one who remembers Allah, does the latter one means striking? Jazakumullah 1778 views Q. I am giving you some names. Please tell me their meanings and are they authentic Islamic names 7925 views Q. 1488 views Q. Name 2125 views Q. my name is Muhammad Asif Mehmood I have a son, his name is Abdul Rafay, now Allah blessed me with a daughter and i want to give her islamic name please advise. 2402 views Q. I would like to know if we can name our son Mustafa? I am confused since his complete name will be Syed Muhammad Mustafa. Is it permissible? 6409 views Q. I have put my daughter name "ZUNAIRAH". Is this name is correct according to Islam and what its actual meanings. i also want to add something before her name. Plz suggest what. 15061 views Q. I have been blessed with a daughter. I am looking for some names. One name came to my mind Urooj fatima. Urooj is male name. So this name Uroj fatima is suitable for a girl or not? 2251 views Q. Name 1818 views Q. My daughter name is shazia saleem i want to know what is the meaning of name and this name is good or not my husband didn't ask anybody when he choose the name. plz send me replay soon. 2864 views Q. Who has rights name the baby 4628 views Q. 1. We have named a child Subhan Ahmed Keen, knowing Subhan is name of Allah Subhan wa tallah but since it does not come in the 99 names of Allah we thought it was ok to use it. Now we have read in Maaruf ul Quraan where Mufti Shafi says that except 4-5 names of Allah other names (he mentions Subhan cannot be used; on page 134 Vol4, Aayat 180 of Surat Al Aaraaf) cannot be used. Please guide us. 5060 views Q. opinion of name 2058 views Q. reading surah mohammed during pregnancy 4109 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 34905 Country: India Title: نام ” ایان “ کے معنی بتائیں ؟ اور کیا یہ اچھا نام ہے؟ Question: نام ” ایان “ کے معنی بتائیں ؟ اور کیا یہ اچھا نام ہے؟ Answer ID: 34905 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! فتوی(م): 1672=1672-11/1432 اَیَّان یہ عربی زبان میں برائے شرط اور وقت کے مستعمل ہوتا ہے، نام رکھنے کے لیے یہ لفظ موزوں نہیں، اگر عین کے ساتھ عَیان ہو تو نام درست ہے، اس کے معنی ظاہر اور نمایاں کے ہیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
